    (_hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (_hS : 0 ≤ S) (_hT : 0 ≤ T) (_hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hP : P ≤ 2) (hDF : 0 ≤ DF)
    (_hlg0 : 0 ≤ lg) (hlg : lg ≤ ℓ) (he : 552960 * ℓ ≤ e) (hE : e ≤ E)
    (h1 : -12 * Q ≤ 6 * ℓ * (ℓ + 5) * D - ℓ * (ℓ + 1) * Q + 24 * ℓ * S +

    (h2 : D ≤ DF + 2 * lg + 21) (h3 : S ≤ 2 * d * DF + 5 + lg) (h4 : 2 * T ≤ 3 * E) :
    ℓ * Q ≤ 6 * (ℓ + 20 * d) * DF + 120 * ℓ * E := by

payload.theorem_title: Numerical assembly of the main bound — 主界的数值组合 — 主評価の数値的組合せ
payload.natural_language_statement:
**English**

For every choice of real numbers $\ell,d,D,Q,S,T,P,\mathrm{DF},E,e,\mathrm{lg}$, assume all the following conditions: $$\begin{gathered}7\le\ell,\quad1\le d,\quad0\le D,\quad0\le Q,\quad0\le S,\quad0\le T,\quad0\le P,\quad P\le2,\quad0\le\mathrm{DF},\quad0\le\mathrm{lg},\quad\mathrm{lg}\le\ell,\\552960\ell\le e,\quad e\le E,\\-12Q\le6\ell(\ell+5)D-\ell(\ell+1)Q+24\ell S+24\ell(\ell+5)T+6\ell(\ell+5)P,\\D\le\mathrm{DF}+2\mathrm{lg}+21,\quad S\le2d\,\mathrm{DF}+5+\mathrm{lg},\quad2T\le3E.\end{gathered}$$ Then $$\ell Q\le6(\ell+20d)\mathrm{DF}+120\ell E.$$ Here $\mathrm{DF}$ and $\mathrm{lg}$ are individual real variables. In particular, $\ell$ and $d$ are real numbers; the conditions impose no integrality or primality requirement. The six conditions $0\le D$, $0\le Q$, $0\le S$, $0\le T$, $0\le P$, and $0\le\mathrm{lg}$ remain premises although their named hypotheses are not referenced in the source proof. The conditions allow $Q,S,T,P,\mathrm{DF},\mathrm{lg}$ to be zero; they imply $\ell>0$ and $E\ge e\ge552960\ell>0$.

**简体中文**

**日本語**

任意の実数 $\ell,d,D,Q,S,T,P,\mathrm{DF},E,e,\mathrm{lg}$ に対して、次の条件をすべて仮定する：$$\begin{gathered}7\le\ell,\quad1\le d,\quad0\le D,\quad0\le Q,\quad0\le S,\quad0\le T,\quad0\le P,\quad P\le2,\quad0\le\mathrm{DF},\quad0\le\mathrm{lg},\quad\mathrm{lg}\le\ell,\\552960\ell\le e,\quad e\le E,\\-12Q\le6\ell(\ell+5)D-\ell(\ell+1)Q+24\ell S+24\ell(\ell+5)T+6\ell(\ell+5)P,\\D\le\mathrm{DF}+2\mathrm{lg}+21,\quad S\le2d\,\mathrm{DF}+5+\mathrm{lg},\quad2T\le3E.\end{gathered}$$ このとき $$\ell Q\le6(\ell+20d)\mathrm{DF}+120\ell E.$$ が成り立つ。ここで $\mathrm{DF}$ と $\mathrm{lg}$ は、それぞれ一つの実数変数である。$\ell$ と $d$ も実数であり、整数性や素数性は条件に含まれない。$0\le D$、$0\le Q$、$0\le S$、$0\le T$、$0\le P$、$0\le\mathrm{lg}$ の六つの仮定は、ソースコードの証明でその仮定名が参照されていなくても、声明の前提である。条件は $Q,S,T,P,\mathrm{DF},\mathrm{lg}$ がゼロである場合を許し、$\ell>0$ および $E\ge e\ge552960\ell>0$ を導く。

**Paper source context (English)**

The paper context is Shinichi Mochizuki, Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory IV (April 2020), proof of Theorem 1.10, Step (viii), printed/PDF pp. 30–31. The step sums the local procession-normalized upper bounds obtained in Steps (v)–(vii), combines the sum with the arithmetic estimate from Step (iii), and bounds the prime-counting contribution l*_mod·log(s^≤). On p. 31 the latter is at most (4/3)(e*_mod·ℓ + η_prm), regardless of whether e*_mod·ℓ is above or below η_prm. The remaining logarithmic and constant errors are absorbed into this term. The final paragraph then obtains the theorem’s numerical constants using ℓ ≥ 7 and d_mod ≥ 1, in particular the estimates (1 − 12/ℓ²)^(−1) ≤ 2 and (1 − 12/ℓ²)^(−1)(1 + 12d_mod/ℓ) ≤ 1 + 20d_mod/ℓ. The reference implementation extracts this numerical assembly into a separate real-inequality helper. The paper does not state a separately numbered lemma with the helper’s full list of parameters and hypotheses.

The printed prime-counting factor in this step is 4/3. The reference implementation’s numerical helper accepts the weaker inequality 2T ≤ 3E, corresponding to factor 3/2, and uses a direct polynomial comparison with sufficient slack to retain the final constants. Thus the helper is an implementation-level extraction of the paper’s numerical argument, not a literal transcription of its intermediate formulas or a paper theorem bearing the name assembly.
